identity.name: Golden Lakes Village
identity.notes: 55+ age-restricted gated community in West Palm Beach, FL 33411, comprising Phase A (~1,088 units) and Phase B (~800 homes) under a master corporation. Villas and condos built 1974–1992. HOA established 12/21/1972. Managed by Anzen Group (Phase B) and FPMS (property management).

fees.note: Range approximately $177–$647/month depending on unit type and phase (Phase A vs Phase B). Exact amounts, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments vary and require direct inquiry to the association or property manager (Anzen Group: 561-689-8966; FPMS: 941-960-5000).

HOA dues listed as $177-$647/mo; range varies by unit type (villa vs condo) and phase. Third-party listing site, unverified by HOA. (Upper bound $647/mo.) Retrieved via page summary; see also hoabulletinboard.com which cites the same ~$177-$647 range depending on unit type and phase under the master corporation (Phase A ~1,088 units / Phase B ~800 homes). No CDD special assessments found in sources reviewed. HOA fee per hoa-community.com covers: common area maintenance, exterior maintenance, common insurance, reserves, trash removal, water, sewer (no dollar amount stated). Average WPB condo HOA ~$485/mo per hoa-agent.com (area average, not community-specific). Confidence 0.5-0.6 (reputable listing/aggregator, not official).

No dollar amount published; page states fee includes common area maintenance, exterior maintenance, common insurance, reserves, trash removal, water, sewer. Community features listed: clubhouse, pool. Unaffiliated aggregator; verify with HOA/manager (Anzen Group for Phase B, FPMS property management).

amenities.detail: Two clubhouses across Phase A and Phase B
Multiple swimming pools including Olympic-sized pool
Gated community with master corporation overseeing common areas
Social events, fitness classes, entertainment coordinated by a lifestyle director
Olympic-size pool & spa, plus 5 satellite pools throughout the community (official Phase B HOA site, managed by Anzen Group LLC).
Beautiful surrounding lakes within the community (official Phase B site).
Two clubhouses with billiards room, card room, on-site library, and multipurpose gathering spaces for activities, clubs, and classes.
Tennis courts; tennis listed as a resident club/activity.
Gated community (55+ age-restricted); lock-and-leave condo lifestyle.
Full-time activities director; outdoor patios; scenic ponds and waterways.

Phase A (1,088 condos/villas, built mid-1970s): social activities director with shows, dances, trips; exercise classes, water aerobics, bridge/card clubs, knitting, bingo; bus service several days a week for non-drivers.
